problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a specialized courier to transport high-value artifacts between 7 distinct regional museums.

The travel durations between museums are precisely recorded in minutes:
* Museum Alpha to Museum Beta: 182.4 minutes
* Museum Alpha to Museum Gamma: 81.9 minutes
* Museum Alpha to Museum Delta: 135.1 minutes
* Museum Alpha to Museum Epsilon: 132.7 minutes
* Museum Alpha to Museum Zeta: 18.1 minutes
* Museum Alpha to Museum Eta: 252.6 minutes
* Museum Beta to Museum Gamma: 183.5 minutes
* Museum Beta to Museum Delta: 106.1 minutes
* Museum Beta to Museum Epsilon: 60.7 minutes
* Museum Beta to Museum Zeta: 182.5 minutes
* Museum Beta to Museum Eta: 160.0 minutes
* Museum Gamma to Museum Delta: 93.1 minutes
* Museum Gamma to Museum Epsilon: 156.7 minutes
* Museum Gamma to Museum Zeta: 99.5 minutes
* Museum Gamma to Museum Eta: 195.5 minutes
* Museum Delta to Museum Epsilon: 109.1 minutes
* Museum Delta to Museum Zeta: 145.7 minutes
* Museum Delta to Museum Eta: 118.2 minutes
* Museum Epsilon to Museum Zeta: 129.0 minutes
* Museum Epsilon to Museum Eta: 200.4 minutes
* Museum Zeta to Museum Eta: 263.8 minutes

The objective is to determine the minimal total duration circuit that permits the courier to arrive at each museum precisely once before concluding the circuit at the initial departure point.
